parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

parameters.name: QueueName
parameters.description:
The name of the destination queue.

You can call the [ListQueues](~~92176~~) operation to query the queue name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc set-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name work --node Name=compute1 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc SetQueue --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --Node.1.Name compute1 --QueueName work
